meta.notes: The material: a gem the glowshard ore drops. Every recipe of the set uses it, and it repairs the set's tools and armour on an anvil through the tag msm_examples:glowshard_repair_materials. Its vanilla component minecraft:provides_trim_material (set through msm:components) names the trim material msm_examples:glowshard_trim, so it also trims armour at a smithing table.
